title: Telemetry ops
description: Is the demo healthy? Status row first; mission checks, real data, writes per minute and Airflow runs below; raw counts under Details. Read-only; provisioned from infra/grafana/dashboards.

panels.title: Pipeline
panels.description: Synthetic data path (simulator -> Redpanda -> consumer -> database), from the 8 tables written every tick. Red: a table not written for 5 min. Orange: newest write 2-5 min old, or under 50 writes/min over the last 10 min (also for ~8 min after a simulator restart). First check: `docker compose ps`, then `docker compose logs --tail 50 physics_models physics_models_consumer`.

targets.rawSql:
-- 2 = a tick table not written for 5 min; 1 = newest write 2-5 min old, or < 500 writes in 10 min (60/min expected)
WITH t AS (
  SELECT max(ingested_at) AS last, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') AS w10 FROM state_snapshot
  UNION ALL SELECT max(ingested_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') FROM thermal_output
  UNION ALL SELECT max(ingested_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') FROM power_output
  UNION ALL SELECT max(ingested_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') FROM comms_output
  UNION ALL SELECT max(ingested_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') FROM radiation_output
  UNION ALL SELECT max(ingested_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') FROM cross_model_state
  UNION ALL SELECT max(ingested_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') FROM telemetry_packet
  UNION ALL SELECT max(ingested_at), count(*) FILTER (WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '10 minutes') FROM ml_feature_vectors
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN bool_or(last IS NULL OR last < now() - interval '5 minutes') THEN 2
  WHEN bool_or(last < now() - interval '2 minutes' OR w10 < 500) THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END AS status
FROM t

panels.title: Real data
panels.description: Daily sources (JPL CAD, DONKI, GOES) by write time: orange over 26 h, red over 36 h. Backfill tables (Horizons, OEM, timeline) only need rows: red if one is empty. First check: the Airflow tile and the 'Real data: last written' table; empty backfill table: run `real_data_backfill`.

targets.rawSql:
-- daily sources: 1 if older than 26 h, 2 if older than 36 h; backfill tables: 2 if empty
WITH t AS (
  SELECT 'daily' AS kind, max(ingested_at) AS last, count(*) AS n FROM close_approaches
  UNION ALL SELECT 'daily', max(fetched_at), count(*) FROM donki_events
  UNION ALL SELECT 'daily', max(ingested_at), count(*) FROM goes_integral_protons
  UNION ALL SELECT 'backfill', NULL::timestamptz, count(*) FROM orion_ephemeris
  UNION ALL SELECT 'backfill', NULL::timestamptz, count(*) FROM moon_ephemeris
  UNION ALL SELECT 'backfill', NULL::timestamptz, count(*) FROM dsn_site_geometry
  UNION ALL SELECT 'backfill', NULL::timestamptz, count(*) FROM oem_state_vectors
  UNION ALL SELECT 'backfill', NULL::timestamptz, count(*) FROM mission_events
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN bool_or(n = 0) OR bool_or(kind = 'daily' AND (last IS NULL OR last < now() - interval '36 hours')) THEN 2
  WHEN bool_or(kind = 'daily' AND last < now() - interval '26 hours') THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END AS status
FROM t

panels.title: Airflow
panels.description: Red: the latest real_data_refresh failed, or none succeeded in 36 h. Orange: last success 26-36 h ago, or the latest hand-run real_data_backfill failed. First check: the failed task's log in the Airflow UI (SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:8080), then `docker compose ps` for the airflow-* services.

targets.rawSql:
-- 2 = latest real_data_refresh failed, or no success in 36 h; 1 = last success 26-36 h ago, or the latest backfill failed
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dag_id) dag_id, state FROM dag_run ORDER BY dag_id, start_date DESC NULLS LAST
), ok AS (
  SELECT max(end_date) AS t FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = 'real_data_refresh' AND state = 'success'
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN (SELECT state FROM latest WHERE dag_id = 'real_data_refresh') = 'failed' THEN 2
  WHEN (SELECT t FROM ok) IS NULL OR (SELECT t FROM ok) < now() - interval '36 hours' THEN 2
  WHEN (SELECT t FROM ok) < now() - interval '26 hours'
    OR (SELECT state FROM latest WHERE dag_id = 'real_data_backfill') = 'failed' THEN 1
  ELSE 0 END AS status

panels.title: Replay position
panels.description: Simulated time of the newest synthetic write (UTC) and how far through the trajectory data the replay loop is. Information only: a stuck replay shows as Pipeline: Stopped.

targets.rawSql:
-- Simulated time of the newest write and how far through the trajectory data it is
WITH last AS (SELECT timestamp_utc FROM telemetry_packet ORDER BY ingested_at DESC LIMIT 1),
     span AS (SELECT min(timestamp_utc) AS a, max(timestamp_utc) AS b FROM telemetry_packet)
SELECT to_char(last.timestamp_utc, 'Mon DD HH24:MI') || ' UTC · '
       || round(100 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM last.timestamp_utc - span.a) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM span.b - span.a), 0)) || '%'
       AS "position"
FROM last, span

panels.title: Database use
panels.description: Size of all databases against the managed plan's 10 GiB: orange over 70%, red over 80%. Database files only; the UpCloud console shows the full disk use. First check: 'Rows per table' and 'Database size' under Details.

targets.rawSql:
-- Every database this user can open, against the managed plan's 10 GiB (database files only, not WAL)
SELECT sum(pg_database_size(datname))::float8 / (10 * 1024^3) * 100 AS "used"
FROM pg_database
WHERE datallowconn AND NOT datistemplate AND has_database_privilege(datname, 'CONNECT')

panels.title: Mission checks
panels.description: Whole-mission checks on the stored synthetic data (all loops overwrite the same simulated timestamps, so these hold mid-loop too). Failed (red) = broken or missing data: check the consumer log for rejected ticks. Check (orange) = the model output changed: expected after a physics model PR, which should update the expected value in this panel.

targets.rawSql:
-- Whole-mission checks. Expected values from the #88 full-loop check; a model PR that changes the
-- no-link count or the final dose updates them here. Red = broken data, orange = changed model output.
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n FROM state_snapshot
  UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM thermal_output
  UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM power_output
  UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM comms_output
  UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM radiation_output
  UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM cross_model_state
  UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry_packet
  UNION ALL SELECT count(*) FROM ml_feature_vectors
), gaps AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (
    SELECT timestamp_utc - lag(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS d FROM telemetry_packet
  ) s WHERE d > interval '60 seconds'
), empty AS (
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE belt_dose_rate_rad_s IS NULL) + count(*) FILTER (WHERE gcr_dose_rate_rad_s IS NULL)
               + count(*) FILTER (WHERE cumulative_belt_dose_krad IS NULL) + count(*) FILTER (WHERE radiation_zone IS NULL)
          FROM radiation_output)
       + (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE dsn_visibility IS NULL) + count(*) FILTER (WHERE link_loss_reason IS NULL)
               + count(*) FILTER (WHERE radiation_zone IS NULL)
          FROM telemetry_packet) AS n
), link AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE comm_state = 'NO_LINK') AS no_link,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE (comm_state = 'NO_LINK') <> (link_loss_reason <> 'NONE')) AS disagree
  FROM telemetry_packet
), dose AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE c < prev) AS decreases,
         (array_agg(c ORDER BY timestamp_utc DESC))[1] * 10000 AS final_mgy
  FROM (SELECT timestamp_utc, cumulative_dose_krad AS c,
               lag(cumulative_dose_krad) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS prev
        FROM radiation_output) s
)
SELECT "Check", "Value", "Expected",
       CASE status WHEN 0 THEN 'OK' WHEN 1 THEN 'Check' ELSE 'Failed' END AS "Status"
FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS o, 'Ticks in each of the 8 tick tables' AS "Check",
         CASE WHEN min(n) = max(n) THEN min(n)::text ELSE min(n) || ' to ' || max(n) END AS "Value",
         '12834' AS "Expected", CASE WHEN min(n) = 12834 AND max(n) = 12834 THEN 0 ELSE 2 END AS status FROM counts
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Gaps over 60 s in simulated time', n::text, '0', CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 2 END FROM gaps
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Empty fields (radiation and packet)', n::text, '0', CASE WHEN n = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 2 END FROM empty
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Link state and loss reason disagree', disagree::text, '0', CASE WHEN disagree = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 2 END FROM link
  UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Times the cumulative dose decreases', decreases::text, '0', CASE WHEN decreases = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 2 END FROM dose
  UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'No-link ticks (DSN view + Moon)', no_link::text, '1401', CASE WHEN no_link = 1401 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM link
  UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Final dose (mGy)', round(final_mgy::numeric, 2)::text, '13.52',
         CASE WHEN round(final_mgy::numeric, 2) = 13.52 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END FROM dose
) s
ORDER BY o

panels.title: Real data: last written
panels.description: Daily sources (refreshed by Airflow at 00:00 UTC) are Late after 26 h and Stale after 36 h. Backfill sources are loaded once, so their age is not a problem; they only need rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS "table", schedule, n AS "rows", last AS "last written",
       round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last) / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS "hours ago",
       CASE
         WHEN n = 0 THEN 'Empty'
         WHEN schedule = 'backfill' THEN 'OK'
         WHEN last < now() - interval '36 hours' THEN 'Stale'
         WHEN last < now() - interval '26 hours' THEN 'Late'
         ELSE 'OK' END AS "status"
FROM (
  SELECT 'close_approaches (JPL CAD)' AS t, 'daily' AS schedule, max(ingested_at) AS last, count(*) AS n FROM close_approaches
  UNION ALL SELECT 'donki_events (NASA DONKI)', 'daily', max(fetched_at), count(*) FROM donki_events
  UNION ALL SELECT 'goes_integral_protons (NASA iSWA)', 'daily', max(ingested_at), count(*) FROM goes_integral_protons
  UNION ALL SELECT 'orion_ephemeris (JPL Horizons)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at), count(*) FROM orion_ephemeris
  UNION ALL SELECT 'moon_ephemeris (JPL Horizons)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at), count(*) FROM moon_ephemeris
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dsn_site_geometry (JPL Horizons)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at), count(*) FROM dsn_site_geometry
  UNION ALL SELECT 'oem_state_vectors (NASA OEM)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at), count(*) FROM oem_state_vectors
  UNION ALL SELECT 'mission_events (timeline)', 'backfill', max(ingested_at), count(*) FROM mission_events
) s
ORDER BY schedule DESC, 1

panels.title: Synthetic writes per minute (8 tick tables)
panels.description: Rows the consumer wrote per minute, per table; the dashed line is the expected 60 (one tick per second at 60x). All lines should overlap. A dip in one table only = that table's insert fails (consumer log); a gap in all = the pipeline or the database stopped.

targets.rawSql:
-- Complete minutes only (the current minute is always partial)
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ingested_at) AS time, metric, count(*) AS "writes"
FROM (
  SELECT 'state_snapshot' AS metric, ingested_at FROM state_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'thermal_output', ingested_at FROM thermal_output WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'power_output', ingested_at FROM power_output WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'comms_output', ingested_at FROM comms_output WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'radiation_output', ingested_at FROM radiation_output WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cross_model_state', ingested_at FROM cross_model_state WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'telemetry_packet', ingested_at FROM telemetry_packet WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ml_feature_vectors', ingested_at FROM ml_feature_vectors WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at)
) s
WHERE ingested_at < date_trunc('minute', now())
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Airflow: latest DAG runs
panels.description: The 15 most recent runs of the ingest DAGs (real_data_refresh: daily; real_data_backfill: by hand). Details and logs: the Airflow UI.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dag_id AS "DAG", run_type AS "type", state, start_date AS "started",
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_date - start_date)::int AS "seconds"
FROM dag_run
ORDER BY start_date DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Synthetic data: seconds since last write
panels.description: Per tick table, how long ago the consumer last wrote a row (ingested_at). anomaly_events is left out: the anomaly model is a placeholder and writes no rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS "table", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last)::int AS "seconds ago"
FROM (
  SELECT 'state_snapshot' AS t, max(ingested_at) AS last FROM state_snapshot
  UNION ALL SELECT 'thermal_output', max(ingested_at) FROM thermal_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'power_output', max(ingested_at) FROM power_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'comms_output', max(ingested_at) FROM comms_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'radiation_output', max(ingested_at) FROM radiation_output
  UNION ALL SELECT 'cross_model_state', max(ingested_at) FROM cross_model_state
  UNION ALL SELECT 'telemetry_packet', max(ingested_at) FROM telemetry_packet
  UNION ALL SELECT 'ml_feature_vectors', max(ingested_at) FROM ml_feature_vectors
) s
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rows per table
panels.description: Exact row counts of every table in the telemetry database (the tables are small).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT table_name AS "table",
       (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) AS c FROM %I.%I', table_schema, table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS "rows"
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Size of each database this user can open (the managed plan has 10 GiB in total).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT datname AS "database", pg_database_size(datname) AS "size"
FROM pg_database
WHERE datallowconn AND NOT datistemplate AND has_database_privilege(datname, 'CONNECT')
ORDER BY 1
